query: Here is my implementation plan for the coin-pickup mechanic in our mobile platformer: 'On trigger enter with the coin, call score += 1, destroy the coin GameObject immediately, done. No particles, no sound, no haptic, keep it minimal so we stay inside the frame budget.' Ready to build this?
expected_behavior: Names the defect explicitly: the plan delivers zero feedback (no visual, no audio, no haptic) on a core player action, violating the Juice Protocol / Trinity of Feedback
Rejects the 'keep it minimal for frame budget' justification, explaining a particle burst, a one-shot sound, and a haptic tap cost negligible frame time and do not conflict with the 60fps floor
Prescribes the Trinity of Feedback concretely: a visual response (particle burst or squash-stretch) on pickup, an audio cue aligned within one frame, and a light haptic impact on mobile
Flags the instant destroy-on-trigger as removing the moment for feedback to register, and recommends a brief pickup animation or delay before the object is removed
Does not approve the plan to build as described
